info.title: Voucherify API - Product Collections
info.description: Voucherify promotion engine REST API. Please see https://docs.voucherify.io/docs for more details.

get.description:
This method returns a list of product collections.

<Note>A restricted user sees only the product collections assigned to their areas and stores. A restricted user is a user with the Restricted user role, or with a custom role that has the Join areas and stores permission. An API key with the Restricted user role is also restricted.</Note>

200.description: Returns a dictionary containing a list of product collections and details about each product collection.

post.description:
Creates a new product collection.

To assign the collection to areas, stores, or all stores, send `access_settings` with `assign`. Assignments are available only when the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for product collections.

<Note>A restricted user must assign the new collection to at least one area or store. Areas and stores that the restricted user isn't assigned to are ignored. If none are left, the request fails with a 400 error. A restricted user is a user with the Restricted user role, or with a custom role that has the Join areas and stores permission. An API key with the Restricted user role is also restricted. Users who can't join areas and stores can assign any area or store.</Note>

200.description: Returns information about the newly created collection, as well as an array containing the products.

400.description: Returns an error if the request data is invalid, the static collection contains products or SKUs that don't exist, a restricted user creates the collection without any area or store assignment, or the project has reached its product collection limit.

put.description:
Updates the product collection.

For `STATIC` collections, you can update only the `name` and `access_settings`.

For `AUTO_UPDATE` collections, you can update its `name`, `filters`, and `access_settings`.

<Note>If the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for product collections, you can send `access_settings` to assign or unassign areas and stores. A restricted user can't update a product collection that is read-only for them or that is not assigned to their areas and stores. Contact [Voucherify Sales](https://www.voucherify.io/contact-sales) to learn more.</Note>

delete.description:
Deletes a product collection.

<Note>If the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for product collections, the area and store assignments of the product collection are deleted with it. A restricted user can't delete a product collection that is read-only for them or that is not assigned to their areas and stores. Contact [Voucherify Sales](https://www.voucherify.io/contact-sales) to learn more.</Note>

<Warning>This endpoint performs database-heavy operations. It is not designed for highly frequent use.</Warning>

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Limits the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100 items. If no limit is set, it returns 10 items.

page.name: page
page.description: Which page of results to return. The lowest value is `1`.

order.name: order
order.description: Sorts the results using one of the filtering options, where the dash `-` preceding a sorting option means sorting in a descending order.

starting_after.name: starting_after
starting_after.description: Timestamp representing the date and time to use in starting_after cursor to get more data. Represented in ISO 8601 format.

key.description: Short string describing the kind of error which occurred.

message.description: A human-readable message providing a short description of the error.

details.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error.

request_id.description: This ID is useful when troubleshooting and/or finding the root cause of an error response by our support team.

resource_id.description: Unique resource ID that can be used in another endpoint to get more details.

error.description: Includes the resolved custom validation-rule error message when one is configured.

message.description: Resolved custom validation-rule error message for `options.language`, falling back to the Error Message Library default language. Present only when a custom message can be resolved.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the product collection was last updated. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

<Note>If the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for product collections, this list does not return `access_settings_assignments`. ProductCollectionsItem.title: Product Collection Base
ProductCollectionsItem.description: This is an object representing a product collection base.

type.description: Describes whether the product collection is dynamic (products come in and leave based on set criteria) or static (manually selected products).

filter.description: Defines a set of criteria and boundary conditions for an `AUTO_UPDATE` product collection type.

products.description: Defines a set of products for a `STATIC` product collection type.

object.description: Denotes the type of the object represented by the ID.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the product collection was created. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

readonly.description: Indicates whether the product collection can only be read by the caller in the Areas and Stores enterprise feature. Returned only when area and store visibility rules apply to the caller. A read-only product collection can't be updated or deleted.

object.description: The type of the object represented by JSON. This object stores information about the static product collection.

Junction.title: Junction
Junction.description: Logical Operator Between Filters. Filter by conditions set on the `junction` parameter indicating how the `conditions` should be accounted for in the query. An `AND` is an all-inclusive logical operator, meaning the `AND` operator displays a record if **ALL** the conditions separated by AND are TRUE, while  an `OR` operator displays a record if **ANY** of the conditions separated by OR is TRUE.

conditions.description: Data filters used to narrow down the data records to be returned in the result.

AccessSettingsProductCollectionAssignmen.title: Access Settings Product Collection Assignments List
AccessSettingsProductCollectionAssignmen.description:
Lists all assignments of the product collection to areas and stores. The create, update, and get product collection endpoints return this object.

**NOTE**: This object is returned only if the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for product collections. Contact [Voucherify Sales](https://www.voucherify.io/contact-sales) to learn more.

object.description: The type of the object represented by JSON. Default is `list`. This object stores information about product collection assignments to areas and stores

data_ref.description: Identifies the name of the attribute that contains the array of product collection assignments.

data.description: Contains an array of product collection assignments.

total.description: Total number of areas and stores to which the product collection is assigned.

AccessSettings.title: Access Settings
AccessSettings.description:
Assigns or unassigns an area or store to the resource, for example a campaign or a product collection.

<Note>This object can be sent if the Areas and Stores enterprise feature is enabled for the given resource type. Contact [Voucherify Sales](https://www.voucherify.io/contact-sales) to learn more.</Note>

assign.description:
Assigns the resource to an area or a store. Provide the area and/or store IDs in the respective arrays. If a resource changes assignments between areas or stores, unassign it from the area. For example, if a resource is assigned to Area-01, but it must be now assigned to Store-01 within this area, you have to unassign the resource from Area-01 and assign to Store-01 only.

If you want to assign the resource to stores only, you do not have to send the area ID.

areas_ids.description: List all area IDs to which the resource will be assigned.

area_stores_ids.description: List all store IDs to which the resource will be assigned.

area_all_stores_ids.description: List all area IDs where the resource is assigned to all stores in the area. This assignment is not equal to the assignment to all `area_stores_ids` listed separately.

unassign.description:
Unassigns the resource from an area or a store. Provide the area and/or store IDs in the respective arrays. If a resource changes assignments between areas or stores, unassign it first. For example, if a resource is assigned to Area-01, but it must be now assigned to Store-01 within this area, you have to unassign the resource from Area-01 and assigned to Store-01 only.

If you want to assign the resource to stores only, you do not have to send the area ID.

areas_ids.description: List all area IDs from which the resource will be unassigned.

area_stores_ids.description: List all store IDs from which the resource will be unassigned.

area_all_stores_ids.description: List all area IDs where the resource will be unassigned from all stores in the area. This unassignment is not equal to the unassignment from all `area_stores_ids` listed separately.

id.description: Unique product ID assigned by Voucherify.

price.description: Unit price. It is represented by a value multiplied by 100 to accurately reflect 2 decimal places, such as `$100.00` being expressed as `10000`.

attributes.description: A list of product attributes whose values you can customize for given SKUs: `["color","size","ranking"]`. Each child SKU can have a unique value for a given attribute.

metadata.description: The metadata object stores all custom attributes assigned to the product. A set of key/value pairs that you can attach to a product object. It can be useful for storing additional information about the product in a structured format. It can be used to create product collections.

image_url.description: The HTTPS URL pointing to the .png or .jpg file that will be used to render the product image.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the product was created. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the product was updated. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

object.description: The type of the object represented by JSON. This object stores information about the product.

AreaStoreProductCollectionAssignment.title: Areas and Stores Product Collection Assignment
AreaStoreProductCollectionAssignment.description: An object representing an assignment of a product collection to an area or store.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product collection assignment.

area_id.description: Unique identifier of the area to which the product collection is assigned.

all_stores.description: Determines if the product collection is assigned to all of the stores in the area, i.e. if an area ID is passed in the `access_settings.assign.area_all_stores_ids` in the request.

area_store_id.description: Unique identifier of the store to which the product collection is assigned. Not returned when the product collection is assigned to the whole area or to all stores in the area.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the assignment was created. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the assignment was last updated. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

object.description: The type of the object represented by JSON.

Sku.title: SKU Object
Sku.description: This is an object representing a product SKU.

id.description: A unique identifier that represents the SKU and is assigned by Voucherify.

source_id.description: A unique SKU identifier from your inventory system.

price.description: Unit price. It is represented by a value multiplied by 100 to accurately reflect 2 decimal places, such as `$100.00` being expressed as `10000`.

attributes.description: The attributes object stores values for all custom attributes inherited by the SKU from the parent product. A set of key/value pairs that are attached to a SKU object and are unique to each SKU within a product family.

image_url.description: The HTTPS URL pointing to the .png or .jpg file that will be used to render the SKU image.

metadata.description: The metadata object stores all custom attributes assigned to the SKU. A set of key/value pairs that you can attach to a SKU object. It can be useful for storing additional information about the SKU in a structured format. It can be used to create product collections.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the SKU was created. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing the date and time when the SKU was updated. The value is shown in the ISO 8601 format.

object.description: The type of the object represented by JSON. This object stores information about the `SKU`.
